Firmament has no Intersect, and a Sphere takes no features: there is no public Union, Subtract or Intersect of two solids, and a Modify does not admit a Sphere as its target.

Aetheris does not subtract a Sphere from a block: there is no public Subtract, and a Pocket is a prism of a Profile with a flat floor. Its guide says so: "Subtracting a Sphere from a block, a hemispherical arbitrary cavity, public Union / Subtract / Intersect, and general CSG trees are not Preview 3 Firmament features."
Firmament has no Union of two solids: a Model has one material body, a Compose adds only prisms of a Profile to its Base, and a Sphere takes no features.
Firmament has no Intersect of two solids. A Compose could hold both cylinders' discs only in one frame, and these two lie along different axes.
Firmament has no Union of two solids. A Compose adds prisms of a Profile only in its Base's frame, along one axis, and these two cylinders lie along different axes.

Aetheris's EdgeFinish<Chamfer> takes one distance, the same on both faces; it has no chamfer with two distances. (A CornerProfile chamfer of an outline takes two setbacks, but that cuts a corner of a Profile, not the edges round a face.)

Firmament has no Boolean intersection (no public Union, Subtract or Intersect), so it cannot make the common part of the two vaulted blocks. It has no rational B-spline surface for the vaults either, though each is exactly an extruded circular arch.
